info.title: Media Library
info.description:
The Media Library endpoint is used to interact with assets and documents in Media Libraries.

The upload, from-url, refsearch, playback, and subtitle endpoints return 400 for unknown or repeated query parameters. Only `tag` and `debug` are ignored.

servers.description: Parameterized base URL for Sanity API endpoints

projectId.description: Your Sanity project ID. This can be found in your project settings or in the URL when accessing your project in the Sanity management interface.

apiVersion.description: The version of the API to use. This should match the version specified in the info.version field.

post.summary: Mutate media in the Media Library
post.description:
You can use this endpoint to create, update, or delete documents in the Media Library.
This uses the same mutation syntax as Content Lake's [Mutation API](https://www.sanity.io/docs/http-reference/mutation).

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Validate the mutations and return the result without saving any changes.

operation.description: The operation performed, such as `create`, `update`, or `delete`

get.summary: Query media in the Media Library
get.description:
Use GROQ to query the Media Library.

Requests without a token are allowed, but return only data that is publicly readable. On a private library they return an empty result rather than an error.

See the [GROQ documentation](https://www.sanity.io/docs/groq) for more information on writing GROQ queries.

schema.description: The GROQ query and projection to execute against the Media Library.

query.description: The GROQ query and projection executed against the Media Library.

result.description:
The result of the query. The type of the result depends on the query response.

For example, if the query returns a single document, the result will be an object. If it returns a list of documents, the result will be an array.

syncTags.description: A list of sync tags. Sync tags are used with the [Live Content API](https://www.sanity.io/docs/live-content-api) to track document changes.

post.summary: Query media in the Media Library with a request body
post.description: Same as the GET endpoint, with the query sent in a JSON body. Use this for long queries.

query.description: The GROQ query and projection to execute against the Media Library.

params.description: Values for `$`-prefixed parameters used in the query.

200.description: OK. Same response body as the GET endpoint.

get.description:
Get references to an asset document from other documents and datasets. At this time, this does not support draft or version documents.

Note: this endpoint is currently only available on version `vX` of the API. Requests on dated API versions return 400.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset to get references for.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
A cursor to paginate through the results.
The cursor is returned in the `nextCursor` field of the response.

parameters.name: excludePaths
parameters.description: When `true`, `sourceFieldPaths` is returned as an empty array.

parameters.name: perspective
parameters.description: Only `published` is supported. Any other value returns 400.

sourceDocumentRef.description:
The global document reference ID of the document that references the asset.

This is made up of `{resourceType}:{resourceId}:{documentId}`. For datasets, the resource ID is `{projectId}.{dataset}`.

sourceFieldPaths.description: A list of field path locations in the document that reference the asset.

totalCount.description: Number of references in this page of results. Pages hold at most 100 references.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results. It can be returned even when no more results exist, so keep requesting pages until the response has no `nextCursor`.

post.summary: Upload an asset to the media library

parameters.name: autoGenerateTitle
parameters.description: Generate a title from image content during image processing. Cannot be combined with `title`, even when set to false.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Document ID of the `sanity.directory` to place the uploaded asset in. If omitted, the uploaded asset is not placed in a folder. Must reference a `sanity.directory`, `sanity.tree` is not a valid value.

parameters.name: rootDirectory
parameters.description: Document ID of the root `sanity.directory` for the uploaded asset. Requires `parent` to also be set.

requestBody.description:
The body may be sent in one of two shapes:

- `multipart/form-data` with a required `file` part containing the
  asset bytes and an optional `aspects` part containing a JSON object
  of aspect values to set at creation.
- Raw asset bytes with any other `Content-Type`. The asset is created
  with no aspects.

aspects.description:
Optional JSON object of aspect values to set on the asset
at creation. JSON `null` is accepted and treated as
equivalent to omitting the field. Capped at 1 MiB; larger
payloads return 400.

file.description:
The asset file to upload. Must be the last part in the
multipart body — any parts after `file` are not read,
because the file's reader is consumed lazily by the
upload pipeline.

schema.description:
Raw asset bytes. Any non-`multipart/form-data` request is
treated this way; `application/octet-stream` is the canonical
Content-Type for new clients.

post.summary: Upload an asset to the media library from a URL
post.description:
Fetches a public or preauthorized HTTPS URL through Sanity's bounded
egress proxy, then processes the response with the ordinary Media
Library upload pipeline. The source is limited to 50 MiB and the fetch
may take up to 300 seconds. Caller credentials and headers are not
forwarded to the source. Provide `filename` in the JSON request body;
the `filename` query parameter used by `/upload` is not accepted here.

Follows up to three redirects. The source and each redirect destination
must use HTTPS without embedded credentials and pass the source policy.
The JSON request body is limited to 1 MiB plus 4 KiB, including aspects.

The request stays open while the asset is fetched and uploaded. Allow
more than 300 seconds for the client request. Media processing can
continue after the response. If the connection closes or the request
times out, check the library before retrying: an asset or version may
already have been created.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional asset type override. If omitted, the type is detected from the source content.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Asset title. Cannot be combined with `autoGenerateTitle`. If omitted and `filename` is provided, the filename is used as the initial title.

parameters.name: autoGenerateTitle
parameters.description: Generate a title from image content during image processing. Cannot be combined with `title`, even when set to false.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: Existing asset ID to add a version to. Omit to create an asset. Cannot be combined with an `aspects` object.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Upload session identifier. Must not be empty.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Document ID of the `sanity.directory` to place the uploaded asset in. If omitted, the uploaded asset is not placed in a folder. Must reference a `sanity.directory`, `sanity.tree` is not a valid value.

parameters.name: rootDirectory
parameters.description: Document ID of the root `sanity.directory` for the uploaded asset. Requires `parent` to also be set.

400.description: Invalid or oversized JSON request, invalid URL, blocked source, redirect-limit failure, or empty source

413.description: Source asset exceeds the configured URL ingestion limit

502.description: Source URL did not return a successful response or was unavailable

504.description: Source fetch exceeded the configured URL ingestion time limit

ThumbnailTime.name: thumbnailTime
ThumbnailTime.description: Time in seconds of the frame to use for the thumbnail

ThumbnailFit.name: thumbnailFit
ThumbnailFit.description: How the thumbnail fits the requested width and height

AnimatedStart.name: animatedStart
AnimatedStart.description: Start time in seconds for the animated image

AnimatedEnd.name: animatedEnd
AnimatedEnd.description: End time in seconds for the animated image

AnimatedFps.name: animatedFps
AnimatedFps.description: Frame rate of the animated image

Expiration.name: expiration
Expiration.description: How long signed playback URLs stay valid, as a duration string such as `90s`, `30m`, or `2h`. Only applies to videos with signed playback. Defaults to the video's duration plus a buffer.

DuplicateAsset.description: An asset with the given `sha1` already exists. The error includes `existingAssetId`.

NotModified.description: Not modified. Returned when `If-None-Match` or `If-Modified-Since` matches the current resource. Responses include `ETag` and `Last-Modified` headers.

setIfMissing.description: Fields to set only if they are currently missing

insert.description: Set exactly one of `before`, `after`, or `replace` to a path selecting the array position.

before.description: Insert the items before the selected array element

after.description: Insert the items after the selected array element

replace.description: Replace the selected array elements with the items

items.description: Each mutation object has exactly one key naming the mutation type.

create.description: Create a document. Fails if a document with the same `_id` exists.

createIfNotExists.description: Create a document only if no document with the same `_id` exists.

createOrReplace.description: Create a document, or replace the existing document with the same `_id`.

delete.description: Delete the document with the given `id`.

patch.description: A patch to apply to the media library asset. Uses the [patch format](https://www.sanity.io/docs/http-patches) from the mutate API. One patch can combine several operations, such as `setIfMissing` and `set`.

CDNAccessPolicy.description: CDN access policy for the asset

uploadSession.description: Upload session information, or null when no upload session is returned.

SubtitleInfo.description: Subtitle track information included in playback-info responses

closedCaptions.description: Whether this track represents closed captions

RenditionInfo.description: Downloadable MP4 rendition information included in playback-info responses

url.description: URL to the rendition redirect endpoint

SubtitleResponse.description: Subtitle information returned by generate and upload endpoints

closedCaptions.description: Whether this subtitle represents closed captions

languageCode.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the generated subtitles, or "auto" for auto-detection

url.description: Public or preauthorized HTTPS source URL

filename.description: Optional original filename. It is not inferred from the URL.

aspects.description: Optional JSON object of aspect values to set on the asset at creation. JSON `null` is equivalent to omitting the field. Capped at 1 MiB. Cannot be combined with the `assetId` query parameter.

systemKeyId.description: System key ID used for validation
